description: Read-only Cookidoo CLI for public recipe details and local recipe analysis.

tools.name: recipes_get
tools.description: Get a recipe as schema.org JSON-LD. Required: locale, recipe-id.

params.name: locale
params.description: Cookidoo locale, for example en-US or pt-BR

params.name: recipe-id
params.description: Cookidoo recipe ID, for example r68517

novel_features.name: Multi-Recipe Ingredient Plan
novel_features.description: Combine ingredients from multiple public Cookidoo recipes into one structured plan for review and shopping handoff.
